scope: Third BU implementation pass: Bay State bowed facades and residential entry alignment; CDS public ground floor; corresponding bounded mobile model

references.evidence: Official housing exterior photograph, visually inspected: windowed curved brick bays, stone trim, raised residential entries and planted setbacks. Not a survey of each selected facade.
BU/KPMB 2019 ground landscape plan supports the glazed public frontage and paved approach. Planning material, not an as-built entrance survey.
Architect discussion of public and collaborative ground spaces addressing the street.

evidenceLimits: Existing GIS footprints, source heights and occupied-volume collision are preserved. The terrain is the existing bare-earth DEM, not a door or threshold survey.
Bow-window counts, widths, trim and frame dimensions are authored approximations. The pass restores missing facade articulation without projecting another bay beyond the mapped envelope.
Residential paths are aligned to the existing model door and stoop, not certified real-world door locations. 38 cases remain unaligned and need individual facade review.
CDS columns retain their existing locations; authored door axes move 2.2m east to avoid those columns. No claim that the corrected axes are measured real main entrances.
Closed building interiors remain unimplemented. Mobile retains reduced geometry even in HD material mode.

changes.bayState: Group short convex GIS edges into a continuous street-facing bow; clip complete sash windows across the original facets. Desktop glass is recessed 0.29m with joined sill, jamb and lintel surfaces. Fixed reversed reveal winding and the 0.16m first-row wall gap found during screenshot review.
changes.cds: Recessed dark backing with exterior glazed subdivisions, double doors, heads and transoms. L-shaped paving fills the former 8.48m tower / 3.43m podium gaps. Narrow thresholds and slopes continuously meet the existing DEM apron; adjusted approximate door axes clear retained columns.
changes.mobile: Rebaked Boston; brick entrance surfaces receive the existing XZ brick material in HD. Added 180/192 Bay State bowed facades and the 127/125 pair facing the Bay State arrival. 34 selected brownstones in total; all other lightweight selection limits retained.

validation.unitTests: 101 relevant tests across 12 files passed. After the final mobile-selection addition, 20 decoder/asset tests passed again. Not a complete repository test run.
validation.build: npm run build:cloudflare passed, including TypeScript. 95 assets / 136.93 MiB staged locally; not deployed. Existing large-chunk warnings remain.
validation.fixedViews: Six final same-camera before/after views, visually inspected. Zero page/shader errors, invalid geometry vertices or camera intersections.
validation.comparisonReport: Six image pairs, slider, image loading and 390px viewport layout passed; desktop and mobile report screenshots visually inspected.
validation.mobilePlay: Touch Chromium: all 29 BU destinations, visit recording, movement, HD switch, CDS/Bay State/Link HD rendering, save persistence, safe low-quality reload and viewport fit passed; zero recorded page/WebGL errors. Final Bay State arrival screenshot inspected after adding 127/125.
validation.mobileBudget: Final touch Chromium run: heap peak 76.46 MiB, ArrayBuffer backing 71.94 MiB; within 128/96 MiB regression budgets and no desktop MIT/detail GLBs. This is not a physical iPhone stability result.
